answer: Start by making each identity cost something real to hold. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the lagoon of free entry disappears, the ivory of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the tundra case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Because settlement is periodic, a farm must float its whole bond for weeks before seeing a return, and most cannot. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get cheaper while.
